label: TiO2rutile
note: Ground-state rutile-type TiO2 (Reitz & Dronskowski, Inorg. Chem. 2026, Figure 8b/eq. 9 reference structure for the Pnma-TiO2 decomposition). Superseded history: first computed under this project's plain-PBE extension_ pipeline settings (DeltaICOHP(Pnma->rutile)=-10.05 kJ/mol -- see git history), then re-relaxed (ISIF=3, IBRION=2, SYMPREC=1e-4) and recomputed with METAGGA=R2scan (ENCUT=700) to match the manuscript's own functional. r2SCAN result: relaxed a=4.6011/c=2.9602 A (SI Table S1: a=4.60013/c=2.96018 A, ~0.02% agreement); DeltaICOHP(Pnma->rutile)=-9.48 kJ/mol (manuscript: -9 kJ/mol) and DeltaE=-7.70 kJ/mol (manuscript r2SCAN: -8 kJ/mol, MP: -10 kJ/mol) -- both essentially exact matches. See analysis/REPORT_cao_polymorph_verification.md for full method and the parallel CaO verification.
